requirements.A: add accumulates and total reports the running total
requirements.B: close returns the total and resets the session, so total() is 0 afterwards

add_multiplies.why: combined amounts with multiplication instead of addition

close_does_not_reset.why: close reports the total but leaves the session holding it

reset_only_on_next_add.why: defers the reset until the next add, so total() straight after close is stale
